    <fastagent:skill name="scan_region">
      <fastagent:description>Diagnose the requested ZIP only; available after REFINE activates Region. Never change criteria.</fastagent:description>
    </fastagent:skill>
  </fastagent:skills>
</fastagent:agent>
<fastagent:agent name="reviewer">
  <fastagent:description>PROBE_ROLE=reviewer. First inspect_coverage, then submit_review. Indexed INDEX_COVERAGE_MISMATCH requires REFINE and EXACT_RESCAN_WITH_REGION. Full_csv confirmed sparsity requires ACCEPT_LIMITED and null requested_action. Return submit_review JSON.</fastagent:description>
  <fastagent:skills>
    <fastagent:skill name="inspect_coverage">
      <fastagent:description>Inspect current Price/Supply receipts before choosing a review decision. Do not infer evidence.</fastagent:description>
    </fastagent:skill>
    <fastagent:skill name="submit_review">
      <fastagent:description>Submit your review: indexed mismatch needs REFINE plus EXACT_RESCAN_WITH_REGION;
authoritative confirmed sparsity needs ACCEPT_LIMITED plus null. Returns the accepted decision.</fastagent:description>
    </fastagent:skill>
  </fastagent:skills>
</fastagent:agent>
<fastagent:agent name="composer">
  <fastagent:description>PROBE_ROLE=composer. After acceptance, call compose_report with fact_ids [observations,support] and return its JSON exactly. Never recalculate statistics.</fastagent:description>
  <fastagent:skills>
    <fastagent:skill name="compose_report">
      <fastagent:description>Select both supported facts after acceptance. Render the report from tool receipts, without invented values.</fastagent:description>
    </fastagent:skill>
  </fastagent:skills>
</fastagent:agent>. Delegate per the objective, actual receipts and reviewer feedback. Never fabricate tool results or replace specialists. Region is forbidden before REFINE. Do not mark complete before composer has returned its report.

The overall objective is:

```
<fastagent:objective>
    Run the labeled synthetic index-omission probe with immutable query. First delegate indexed scans to price and supply. Next delegate coverage review to reviewer. If reviewer returns REFINE, replan: delegate new full_csv scans to price and supply AND activate region for diagnostics; then ask reviewer again. Only after ACCEPT_LIMITED delegate report to composer. Every role must call its real tool. Return composer's report through this Orchestrator. Completion requires both review decisions and the report. Region must not run in the first pass.
</fastagent:objective>
```

Produce the next step in the plan to complete the Objective. 

Consider the previous steps and results, and decide what needs to be done next.

Set "is_complete" to true when ANY of these conditions are met:
1. The objective has been achieved in full or substantively
2. The remaining work is minor or trivial compared to what's been accomplished
3. The plan has gathered sufficient information to answer the original request
4. The plan has no feasible way of completing the objective.

Only set is_complete to `true` if there are no outstanding tasks. 

Be decisive - avoid excessive planning steps that add little value. It's better to complete a plan early than to continue with marginal improvements. 

Focus on the meeting the core intent of the objective.
